args.speaker: Skeleton Ancient
args.text: The dead do not stay down...

args.speaker: Vaelor
args.text: You bleed me? Then burn with me!

args.speaker: Astral Tyrant
args.text: The gate yields only to those who endure.

args.speaker: Door
args.text: The door is sealed with bone. The Ancient keeps the key.

args.speaker: Banner
args.text: A tattered banner. The king still sits his throne.

args.speaker: Hearthfold banner
args.text: The Skeleton King is dust. The woods are quiet.

args.speaker: Old Cache
args.text: A mouldy pack by the camp. Search it?

args.speaker: Cael
args.text: The Ancient holds the hall below. I cannot pass it alone.

args.speaker: Cael
args.text: The Ancient falls. I served it once. I will wait for you at \M[GUILD].

args.speaker: Cael
args.text: Where you go, I follow. Mind the king's guard.

args.speaker: Bounty Clerk
args.text: Skeleton acolytes drag the dead back up. Six, and I pay well.

args.prompt: Guildmaster Orla: Companions wait here until you hire them. Anything else?

args.speaker: Guildmaster Orla
args.text: Mira will wait at the guild until you call.

args.speaker: Guildmaster Orla
args.text: Vesper will wait at the guild until you call.

args.speaker: Guildmaster Orla
args.text: Cael will wait at the guild until you call.

args.prompt: Marla: A bed for the night is 100 gold.
Job Master: Whose path shall we walk?

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Mira has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Mira must be a Cleric first.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Mira has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Mira must be a Priest first.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Vesper has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Vesper must be a Necromancer first.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Vesper has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Vesper must be a Lich first.
Vesper is now a Death Lord!

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Cael has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Cael must be a Cultist first.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Cael has not joined you yet.

args.speaker: Job Master
args.text: Cael must be a Zealot first.

args.speaker: Mira
args.text: Stay close and I will keep you standing.

args.speaker: Outfitter
args.text: Mira wears the Vestments of Dawn.

args.speaker: Outfitter
args.text: Vesper wears the Regalia of the Grave.

args.speaker: Outfitter
args.text: Cael wears the Raiment of the Zealot.

args.speaker: Scout
args.text: Mind the east camp. The beast's howl calls the rest.

args.prompt: Showman Pip: Care for a trick?

args.speaker: Vault
args.text: A bone lock. Thread of the Ancient and an iron pick.

args.speaker: Vesper
args.text: The beast keeps the camp. Break it and we talk.

args.speaker: Vesper
args.text: You broke the beast. The dead below will want you next. Find me at \M[GUILD].

args.speaker: Vesper
args.text: Lead on. The dead talk, and I listen.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: Goblins hold the woods road. Thin out four slingers and I will pay.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: The Skeleton King sits on the Ember Throne, past the catacombs.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: The Ancient is down. Only Vaelor is left. Bring herbs as well.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: The catacombs open behind the crypt door at the end of the woods.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: Then the dead are next. The crypt door at the end of the road leads below.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: The Goblin Beast lairs in the clearing, east end of the road.

args.speaker: Warden Thessaly
args.text: The road is safer. Now kill the beast that drives them.

args.prompt: Card Dealer: A card for the third socket?

args.speaker: Hero's Shrine
args.text: Only the brave may stand here.

args.speaker: Mystic Teacher
args.text: Walk the mystic path with me.

args.speaker: Rogue Guild
args.text: Take what is not nailed down.

args.prompt: Smith: What shall I do to Sunbrand?

quests.description: The Warden pays for every skeleton acolyte put down.
A beast drives the goblins. Kill it in its clearing at the end of the road.
The dead stir below the woods. Put the Skeleton Ancient to rest.
Goblin slingers pick off travellers on the woods road. Thin them out.
Pip wants three tricks for the crowd, then a bow.
Vaelor, the Skeleton King, sits on the Ember Throne. End him; bring herbs.
